Decision cutoff: 2024-05-01T23:59:59-04:00. Only information available before this cutoff is admissible.

Source: Karan Aujla Teases Upcoming Track with Exclusive Instagram ‘Frames’ Sticker. Published: 2024-05-01. URL: https://about.fb.com/news/2024/05/karan-aujla-teases-upcoming-track-with-exclusive-instagram-frames-sticker.

Condensed source facts; other details are omitted: Karan Aujla, the acclaimed Punjabi musician famed for his lively and infectious tunes, has just offered a tantalizing preview of his forthcoming track by utilizing Instagram’s newly-released ‘Frames’ sticker. Karan Aujla’s songs have been a sensation on Reels on Instagram. His tracks ‘ Softly ’ and ‘ Admirin’ You ’ have had over 1 million and 480,000 reels created with it. Now, fresh from his win at the prized Juno Awards, he shared an image of his upcoming track ‘ Goin’ Off ‘ using the new ‘Frames’ sticker on Instagram. As an artist, I’m always looking for new ways to engage my audience, and now my 6 million+ followers can just shake the phone with this new Frames sticker, and get a glimpse of my upcoming tracks!” – Karan Aujla
